label: D1 after an a2->S1 rare transition, late in the episode (trial >= ~65)
explanation: Fires only at D1, never at GO or D2. Its main trigger is a D1 step whose previous trial was a rare a2->S1 transition (prev_action 2, prev_state 1), but only late in the episode: it is essentially silent before trial ~55 and its rate climbs steeply over trials 60-99. Value is low whenever it fires (all of its mass falls where the value head is below ~7.1). Without the late-episode condition, the a2->S1 clause has precision 0.35; with it, precision is 0.92 on dev (F1 0.76, mass recall 0.79). It fires after both rewarded and unrewarded rare trials, at about the same per-step magnitude. It does not fire after a1 choices or after common a2->S2 trials, except for weak low-quartile activations. Most of the missed activations are on the first D1 of a window (where the previous trial is outside the window and cannot be checked) or are weak firings one or two trials after an a2->S1 rare event. All predicate variables are observed at D1.
